subject: Sandbox tenant handshake & minimal technical proofs for Contoso listing
messages:
From: Raj Patel <raj.patel@contoso.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: support@contoso.com
Date: Tue, 9 Sep 2025 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Contoso sandbox tenant access + minimal proofs

Hi Mina,

Thanks again for the quick demo last week. Contoso's marketplace team wants to provision a publisher sandbox tenant so we can run the end-to-end registration and manifest push before committing to Co-sell. They asked for a short list of technical proofs so their security folks can sign off:

- Publisher service principal created and sample role assignment (screenshot/log)
- Minimal manifest JSON with plan/SKU mapping (we can use a draft)
- A short smoke test that reaches the sample endpoint (curl output or screenshot)

Can Redwood provide a temporary sandbox tenant or step-by-step guidance to exchange service principal credentials? Ideally we'd get this done in the next 5 business days.

Raj
Senior Program Manager
Contoso Cloud Partnerships

Attachments: contoso_request-090925.pdf

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Raj Patel <raj.patel@contoso.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 9 Sep 2025 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Contoso sandbox tenant access + minimal proofs

Hi Raj — thanks for looping us in. We can definitely support a sandbox handoff. Two options:

1) We provision a temporary publisher sandbox tenant (Redwood-managed) and share short-lived creds for Contoso to push a test manifest.
2) Contoso creates a service principal in your tenant and we provide the exact role assignment + manifest template to validate end-to-end without changing your production settings.

Quick asks so we can size the runbook: which path do you prefer? If you want Redwood-managed sandbox, we'll need the Azure subscription ID we can target (or we can use our infra). If Contoso-managed SP, please share a placeholder principal id so we can prepare the role assignment script.

I'll loop in Marissa for the manifest template and Karthik for the onboarding runbook.

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Director, Partnerships (Marketplace)
Redwood Inference

--
Mina Haddad
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Raj Patel <raj.patel@contoso.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 9 Sep 2025 12:01:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Contoso sandbox tenant access + minimal proofs

Raj / team — attaching a minimal manifest and a short checklist we use for publisher validation. The manifest in the attachment is intentionally minimal (single plan, single SKU) so you can push and confirm the plumbing.

Highlights:
- manifest-minimal.json: replace placeholders for publisherId and offerId before push
- role assignment script: Contributor on the resource group where the Offer is staged (we recommend a dedicated staging RG)
- smoke-test: curl against staging endpoint with API key (we can issue a short-lived key)

If Contoso prefers to create the SP, share the principal id and a preferred start window and we will run the role assignment and share logs. If you'd like Redwood to host the sandbox, say so and we'll provision and send a tenant admin link (24h expiry).

Marissa Cole
Marketplace Onboarding Lead
Redwood Inference

Attachments: manifest-minimal.json; onboarding-checklist.pdf

From: Raj Patel <raj.patel@contoso.com>

We'll create the principal and share the principal id by EOD tomorrow. Can Redwood provide the exact role assignment command (ARM/az CLI) and the manifest placeholders mapping so we can try the push off-hours? Also, any known gotchas for the offer asset URLs (we host behind a signed CDN)?

Raj

>
> Mina

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Raj Patel <raj.patel@contoso.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Sep 2025 10:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Contoso sandbox tenant access + minimal proofs

Raj / team — below are the two az cli snippets we'll use. I included both the SP grant and an alternative ARM role assignment for customers who prefer templated deployments.

1) az ad sp create-for-rbac --name "http://contoso-redwood-staging-sp" --role Contributor --scopes /subscriptions/9f7b-xxxx-zzzz/resourceGroups/contoso-marketplace-staging

2) az role assignment create --assignee <principalId> --role "Contributor" --scope /subscriptions/9f7b-xxxx-zzzz/resourceGroups/contoso-marketplace-staging

Notes / gotchas:
- Ensure the Offer asset URLs return 200/HEAD from Microsoft crawler ranges; we recommend allowing common MS IP blocks (we list them in the checklist).
- If using signed CDN URLs, set a long-enough TTL for the ARTEFACT processor (recommend at least 1 hour on push) or provide an unsigned temporary URL during validation.
- We'll watch the push and share logs; please allow inbound from azuremarketplacevalidation@microsoft.com (we'll include the Marketplace team on the final push window).

I'll attach a quick screenshot of a successful role assignment afterward.

Karthik
Product Ops (Marketplace)
Redwood Inference

Attachment: tenant_screenshot.png

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>

Best,
Mina
